findings.title: Documented command overrides the user's own `features` configuration
findings.body: The `updatecompatibility` macro now hard-codes `--features=rolling-updates` onto every documented `update-compatibility` command. A CLI `--features` value takes precedence over `features` set in `keycloak.conf` or `KC_FEATURES`, and it replaces them rather than adding to them. Users who already enable other features and copy the documented command will generate or check metadata against a different feature set than their real deployment. This contradicts the guide's own warning that all configuration options must be included. The docs should tell users to add `rolling-updates` to their existing feature list, not append a standalone `--features` flag.

findings.title: Exit code 4 changes meaning from 'recreate required' to 'feature disabled'
findings.body: Previously the `check` command exited with 4 when a recreate upgrade was required. Now 3 means recreate and 4 means the `rolling-updates` feature is disabled. Any automation written against the earlier release that maps 4 to 'recreate' and everything else to 'error' will now treat a recreate result (3) as an unexpected failure. This matches the docs, which already listed 3, but the change is incompatible with earlier releases and should be called out in release/upgrade notes.

findings.title: Feature-disabled test doesn't check exit code or cover the `check` subcommand
findings.body: `testFeatureNotEnabled` only checks the error message for the `metadata` subcommand. It does not assert the new documented exit code 4 (`CompatibilityResult.FEATURE_DISABLED`), which is the contract scripts are told to rely on. It also never runs the `check` subcommand with the feature disabled. A regression in the exit code, or in the `check` path, would go unnoticed.
